# artifactkeeper_age_gate (Resource)

Age-based proxy gate for a single `remote` repository: holds newly published upstream versions until they reach a minimum age. A per-repository singleton keyed by repository key (no create/delete); applies only to remote repositories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The age gate applies only to remote (pull-through) repositories. Hold newly
# published upstream versions for 14 days before serving them.
resource "artifactkeeper_age_gate" "npm_remote" {
  repository_key = "npm-remote"
  enabled        = true
  min_age_days   = 14
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the age gate is enforced for this repository.
- `min_age_days` (Number) Minimum age, in days, an upstream version must reach before it is served. `0` is the trusted-remote setting (no delay, but explicit rejections still block). Must be between 0 and 3650.
- `repository_key` (String) Key of the remote repository whose age gate is configured. Changing this forces a new resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Age gates are addressed by their repository key.
terraform import artifactkeeper_age_gate.example docker-local
```
